truth.review: One annotator, second-person QC, additional DevGlobal Tier 1 QC
truth.definition: Rooftop outlines, not surveyed ground footprints, ownership or physical property identities
truth.ignore_policy: Full source raster, no invented ignore regions

building_mask.repository_hash_encoding: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF, matching Git text blobs
building_mask.id_list_hash_encoding: Sorted publisher ids, UTF-8, one id per LF line including final LF

grid.note: Global equal-area WGS84 projection; approximately 1 km locally, not source CRS relabelling.

allocation.dev_deviation_reason: All 20 cells containing the 24 previously evaluated chips must stay DEV-only; their 1434 chips already exceed the nominal 15% target. Leakage prevention takes precedence over target fraction; no seed search, holdout performance or labels influenced cell assignments.

metrics.per_building_precision_recall: One-to-one maximum-cardinality mask IoU >= 0.5, total IoU tie-break; actual production polygon candidates rasterized at source resolution vs one publisher feature per instance; denominators = predicted / publisher buildings. Zero-pixel source features retained as unmatched; count reported.
metrics.mean_iou_of_matches: Sum IoU / count of matched pairs; null when denominator is zero
metrics.false_buildings_on_empty_chips: Count, per-empty-chip rate, affected-chip count, denominator all publisher-empty chips
metrics.boundary_f1_2px: Micro pooled union foreground boundaries, Euclidean tolerance 2 source pixels, border_value=0 erosion; boundary hits and prediction/truth boundary-pixel denominators. Includes false boundaries on empty chips; undefined ratios stay null.
metrics.abstention: Failed inputs reported separately; empty predictions are scored rather than abstentions

inference.input: upright RGB selected crop; at most 2048 pixels per edge and 4,000,000 pixels total; retain source resolution
inference.resize: Each tile uses Pillow bilinear to 432x432; no whole-raster downsampling
inference.output: 200 object logits and 200 mask logits per tile; object sigmoid >0.5; half-pixel bilinear masks resized to tile raster; mask logits >0; higher-confidence instances paint first within each tile
inference.confidence: uncalibrated instance sigmoid; maximum per pixel in tile overlaps, mean over each returned connected candidate
inference.tiling: Single image up to 512 pixels per edge retains instance masks. Larger images: 512-pixel tiles, stride 384, row-major, final tile anchored to far edge, no padding. Union foreground at source pixel coordinates and retain maximum accepted instance confidence per pixel; connected regions become review candidates.

installed_checkpoint_training_data.base_training: COCO 2017 instance segmentation, according to the base model card
installed_checkpoint_training_data.reason: The model names its finetune dataset, but neither card publishes a complete original imagery/chip/source-family inventory. No independent byte/geographic comparison was performed; COCO base provenance does not establish finetune independence from RAMP.

limitations: No spatial buffer between adjacent cells; this measures held-out grid-cell performance, not independent acquisition/city performance.
Installed checkpoint pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
Publisher roof features are not surveyed ground footprints or independent property records.

building_mask_transfer.model_selection: Use completed B4 run with same B3 DEV gate/F1 selection rule across thresholds .3/.5/.7, compared against epoch4 receipts. If none improves on epoch4 by that rule, use epoch4. No transfer-based tuning or selection.
building_mask_transfer.evaluation_profile: Frozen building_mask inference at object threshold .5; even if DEV selected another threshold, transfer reports .5 only to preserve preregistered metrics/profile.
limitations: Cross-geography transfer only, not an Indian accuracy claim.
This region is independent of our project fine-tuning and selection. Undocumented publisher-checkpoint pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
The old B1 split metadata designated all Bangladesh as potential TRAIN; this whole region is reserved now before any project training/selection used it.
